text.en: There is hereby established a cattle breeding station in the Municipality of Balangkayan, Province of Samar, under the supervision of the Director of Animal Industry.
The Director of Animal Industry shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.

The sum of one hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the NaÂ­tional Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the estabÂ­lishment, operation and maintenance of said station for the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-seven. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for its operation and mainÂ­tenance shall be included in the annual General ApproÂ­priations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
